prompts.fullBody: Use case: brand mascot illustration. Create a new full-body paired mascot master for EdgePress: a giant panda on the left and a Taiwanese black bear on the right, naturally standing side by side, relaxed animal paws at their sides, friendly small smiles and slightly turned toward one another. Entire ears, bodies and feet visible with ample transparent margin. Panda has clear white face and belly, black ears, eye patches and limbs. Taiwan bear has deep warm charcoal fur, a warm tan muzzle, and an unmistakable pale cream V chest patch with the entire V including the bottom point clearly visible. Art direction: simple, charming 2D hand-painted gouache and colored-pencil children's book illustration, rounded plump contours, broad matte pigment shapes with light dry-brush grain and delicate pencil edges, restrained warm cream/charcoal/sage palette, small expressive dark eyes. Use simplified fur painted in broad strokes, NOT individual realistic hairs, NOT a 3D render, NOT photorealism, NOT glossy eyes or plastic. Friendly animal anatomy rather than human bodies. NO clothes, NO books, notebooks, computers, tools, accessories, objects in paws, or other props. No text, no badge, no frame, no scenery, no drop shadow or aura. Genuine transparent alpha background.
prompts.avatar: Use the reference only as a character and style reference. Match its simplified rounded 2D gouache and colored-pencil illustration, broad matte pigment and warm friendly small smile. No realistic individual fur hairs, no 3D, no gloss, no clothing, no book, computer, tool or handheld prop. Genuine transparent alpha background with no backdrop, shadow, frame or text. Create a separately designed small-size paired avatar mark: the panda and Taiwanese black bear faces side by side, large clear round faces with ears fully inside a square canvas, smiling toward each other. Preserve the panda markings and bear warm tan muzzle; show the small V marking at the bear's upper chest. Naturally curved complete silhouette below shoulders, not a rectangular portrait crop. Simplify details for recognizability at 16/20/24/32 pixels. Leave transparent margins.
prompts.home: Create a new landscape 3:2 homepage illustration using the reference as exact character/style guidance: the giant panda and Taiwanese black bear standing together, friendly and cooperative. Whole bodies, ears and feet visible, centered and occupying about 70 percent of the canvas height with generous open transparent space around them. Frame the scene very lightly with a few low bamboo leaves on the left and fern fronds on the right painted in muted sage and warm ochre, keeping foliage lower than the animals' knees and separate from their paws. The bear's pale cream V chest patch must be completely visible. Warm simple 2D hand-painted gouache, colored-pencil grain and rounded contours matching the reference. Natural animal poses, no clothing or anthropomorphic objects. No books, notebooks, computers, tools, objects in paws, text, graphic geometric blobs, badges or frames. No scenery rectangle, smoky halo, floor shadow or opaque paper backdrop. Genuine transparent alpha background.

exports: PNG masters preserve generated RGBA alpha. Pillow exports WebP, favicon sizes and 1200x630 cards; functional icons are direct raster drawings from EdgePress tools/assets/generate-brand-assets.py, never converted from SVG.
